summary.text: Mathewos Samson is the Democratic candidate for Georgia House of Representatives District 58 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Torrey Balam (R) in a race with no incumbent.
An engineer and community organizer, he advanced from the June 16 Democratic primary runoff and says he is a democratic socialist running on housing and healthcare.

paragraphs.text: Mathewos Samson earned a high school diploma from Midtown High School, and his career experience includes working as an engineer.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a community organizer and lifelong Atlantan who grew up in Old Fourth Ward, the oldest of three brothers in a family of immigrants from the Tigray region of Ethiopia.
He said he paused university to work as an engineer and support his family, and that he has organized co-workers and spoken at Atlanta City Hall for public transit expansion and affordable housing.
Samson describes himself as a democratic socialist who refuses corporate and developer money.
His stated priorities include rent control, a Tenants Bill of Rights and social housing, and passing the Georgia Medicare for All Act.
